entries.title: Now in beta: New Detection as Code capabilities
entries.description: Exciting news! Our Detections as Code (DaC) improvements to the detection-rules repo are now in beta. In May this year, we shared the Alpha stages of our research into Rolling your own Detections as Code with Elastic Security . Elastic is working on supporting DaC in Elastic Security. While in the future DaC will be integrated within the UI, the current updates are focused on the detection rules repo on main to allow users to set up DaC quickly and get immediate value with available tests and co
